question: The product (a + b) (a - b) (a² - ab + b²) (a² + ab + b²) is equal to :
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Combine terms using **Algebraic Identities**: (a + b)(a² − ab + b²) = a³ + b³ and (a − b)(a² + ab + b²) = a³ − b³.

Product = (a³ + b³)(a³ − b³).

Applying (x + y)(x − y) = x² − y² ⇒ (a³)² − (b³)² = a⁶ − b⁶.

**∴ The correct answer is a⁶ − b⁶.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Expression (a + b)(a − b)(a² − ab + b²)(a² + ab + b²)

**Formula Used:**

1) x³ + y³ = (x + y)(x² − xy + y²)

2) x³ − y³ = (x − y)(x² + xy + y²)

3) (x + y)(x − y) = x² − y²

**Calculations:**

⇒ Rearranging the terms: [(a + b)(a² − ab + b²)] × [(a − b)(a² + ab + b²)]

⇒ Using identities: (a³ + b³) × (a³ − b³)

⇒ Using (x + y)(x − y) property: (a³)² − (b³)²

⇒ a⁶ − b⁶

**∴ The correct answer is a⁶ − b⁶.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Cubes Identity

a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² − ab + b²). This is a fundamental **factorization** identity.

Difference of Cubes Identity

a³ − b³ = (a − b)(a² + ab + b²). Note the **positive middle term** in the quadratic factor.

Difference of Squares

(x + y)(x − y) = x² − y². It is used to simplify the product of **conjugate pairs**.</p
